Overview

This feature service provides stormwater asset point locations maintained by WFN and served through RDCO infrastructure. It supports viewing, reviewing, and managing storm drainage assets within the service area.

Feature Layer

  • WFN Storm Points: A point feature layer representing stormwater infrastructure assets. The layer includes asset identification,  installation details, orientation, and maintenance-related comments, supporting operational stormwater inventory and asset management.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation (WFN) area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases

  • Stormwater asset inventory and field reference
  • Infrastructure maintenance and condition tracking
  • Operational planning for drainage networks
  • Supporting utility GIS workflows

Source and Licensing

The service is created and maintained by Westbank First Nation (WFN) and is hosted on RDCO servers. It is shared under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License, with the accompanying disclaimer and terms of use.
